comparison: Exact published crates verified against official crates.io index SHA256; Cargo.toml.orig retains original bytes. Modified/additional/omitted paths below describe current retained sources, including packaging and test-only differences.

forks.name: comrak
forks.changes: Expose native/direct NativeInput + DirectCompiler and Host-controlled parse execution rather than ordinary parse_document output. Preserve typed accepted value/source claims, source-map proof stages, definition winner identities and AST lifetime/retirement; charge real storage ownership and preserve first failure/cancellation. Implement explicit C0/G3/strict-G4 acceptance for tables, tasks, strikethrough, autolinks and math. Preserve opt-in heading identifiers as source-backed native syntax cuts. Parse named footnote references with metered definition winners and retain their syntax bindings through strict G4 shadow parsing. Capture inline footnote delimiters and body separately, with shared bounded link, code, HTML and math matching. Capture native callout kind, marker, disclosure default and authored inline title on the original quote tree. Retain native highlight and script delimiter scopes across strict G4 shadow parsing and bind emoji aliases to typed source transformations. Let the Host suppress decoded email promotion using the candidate's accepted copied input bounds, preserving generated literal regions without changing ordinary Markdown autolinks.

forks.name: lalrpop-util
forks.changes: Add optional ParserDefinition memory_scope/memory_error/memory_checkpoint hooks and funded state/value stack growth. Admit complete stack groups before allocation/commit, preserve the original operation first fault, and reject controlled error recovery without changing legacy grammars.

forks.name: merman-core
forks.changes: Add parse_flowchart_native_controlled, NativeParsePolicy/NativeFeature/NativeParseError and the native typed flowchart input model consumed by the product. Carry the original MemoryScope/RegionHandle through OperationControl; meter lexical/grammar/model/semantic allocations and work, fallible clones, fixed first faults, and checkpointed entity decoding. Replace flowchart class-definition IndexMap and selected hash containers with funded deterministic native_collections types; adapt Agentflow legacy projection accordingly.

forks.name: merman-render
forks.changes: Development/test-only compatibility with the product core model: seven Rust files accept its OrderedMap class definitions and NativeHashMap tooltips. The old local Dugong memory/work bridge was removed. Cargo.toml pins registry dugong to =0.9.2; root Cargo.lock pins dugong-graphlib to 0.9.2. Upstream render cannot accept these core collection types (17 independently reproduced E0308 errors). Use the pinned Rust toolchain atomic try_update spelling with unchanged orderings and closure.

forks.name: ratex-font
forks.changes: Replace lazily allocated process-wide symbol HashMaps with fixed read-only sorted name/codepoint indexes that preserve original first-match lookup semantics. Expose bounded_readonly_bytes and count fixed symbol/metric payload for the enclosing math asset admission.

forks.name: ratex-layout
forks.changes: Add layout_with_control/layout_with_storage and controlled validation/display traversal. Bound layout boxes, auxiliary data, generated path/string output, recursion and fallible writer operations. Support the existing Chinese text run/fallback measurement bridge without allowing font/layout objects to cross FFI. Reuse bounded font-piece assembly for tall ordinary paired parentheses so valid sums do not fall back, and compose text family/weight/shape across nested commands while preserving default symbol and legacy text-font selection.

forks.name: ratex-lexer
forks.changes: Add controlled/storage-aware token production and fallible bounded token/string cloning. Thread the existing operation through lexer work/admission and preserve legacy entry points.

forks.name: ratex-parser
forks.changes: Add parse_with_control/parse_with_storage, bounded AST/token/string clones, storage/depth/expansion admission and checkpoints throughout parser, functions and macro expansion. Add borrowed fixed builtin macro views and bounded_readonly_bytes to avoid uncharged process-global registries. Reject unsupported bounded builders before entering unsafe/unfunded legacy construction; preserve legacy parse compatibility and elementary math behavior.

forks.name: ratex-types
forks.changes: Add execution.rs: explicit borrowed cancellation/deadline, phase/resource limits, checked work and first-fault state. Add storage.rs: operation-local cumulative allocation admission with old/new overlap, storage family/slot/depth controls, fallible bounded owners and snapshots.

forks.name: data-url
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds request-funded MIME/header/parameter storage, exact decoded child admission, fallible body output, cancellation/work checkpoints inside percent/base64/header scans, and typed first-error propagation. The product usvg image/source classification paths call controlled::DataUrl::process and inspect controlled::Error::Resource; upstream has neither the feature nor this API.
regression_sources: src/resource_tests.rs (paid allocation/free/refund, aggregate/child limits, reserve faults, cancellation and syntax parity)

forks.name: fontdb
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds explicit fallible compatibility clones, immutable request-funded database snapshots and face registration with paid metadata/source owners. The adapter uses Database::try_extend_in/FaceRegistration and bootstrap storage layout; usvg rejects mutation of funded databases using try_clone_unfunded. The feature and APIs are absent upstream.
regression_sources: src/funded/tests.rs (metadata/keys/free-list parity, real free-before-refund, every allocation failure, wrong request and overlapping snapshots)

forks.name: gif
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds controlled first-frame decoding/metadata storage, request-paid palette/output/LZW buffers, work/cancel checkpoints and typed resource errors. resvg calls gif::controlled::ControlledDecoder; it propagates the resources feature to the modified weezl decoder. Upstream cannot satisfy that feature/API or memory/work contract.
regression_sources: fork/resvg-0.49.0/src/raster/gif_tests.rs (controlled first-frame semantics, faulty/truncated GIF corpus, resource failure/cancellation retirement)

forks.name: image-webp
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds a controlled decoder and paid/checkpointed VP8, lossless Huffman/transform, arithmetic, alpha and YUV storage/work paths with resource-aware errors. resvg calls controlled::ControlledDecoder, absent upstream. Byteorder-lite and quick-error can independently return to registry without losing these changes. Suppress dead_code only on retained ordinary constructors and decoded header fields in optimized builds; controlled paths and other lints remain enabled.
regression_sources: src/lossless_transform.rs controlled_regression_tests (single-column predictor work), fork/resvg-0.49.0/src/raster/webp_tests.rs (actual raster parity and fault/cancel paths)

forks.name: simplecss
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds budget-backed stylesheet/selector arenas, cancellable tokenization and matching/backtracking, typed allocation/work/cancel failures, and controlled declaration/font extent parsing. usvg explicitly selects controlled::StyleSheet and controlled::DeclarationTokenizer for paid requests; the feature/module are absent upstream.
regression_sources: tests/controlled.rs (ordinary cascade parity, paid allocations/refunds, cancellable scans/backtracking, font extents and first errors)

forks.name: slotmap
forks.changes: Keep the fork. fontdb funds the actual slot array via initial_storage_layout, try_clone_with_extra_in and try_insert_with_key_noalloc, preserving IDs/holes/free links while rejecting a wrong request before allocating. Ordinary upstream try_insert_with_key/try_reserve does not provide this paid storage contract.
regression_sources: dependencies/fontdb-0.24.0/src/funded/tests.rs (actual funded slot allocations, clone metadata/holes and reserve/commit rollback)

forks.name: svgtypes
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds controlled numeric/length/path/point/font-family parsers with caller-typed checkpoint failures, paid path simplification/arc queues and sink-based font names. usvg calls ControlledSimplifyingPathParser, ControlledPointsParser and parse_*_list_with_control. These APIs are absent upstream; it also deliberately selects the controlled kurbo fork. Suppress dead_code only on retained upstream CSS token helpers in optimized builds; other lints remain enabled.
regression_sources: src/numeric_control.rs, src/path.rs controlled_path_tests, src/points.rs controlled_tests, src/font_sink_tests.rs (float/grammar parity, cancellation, paid queues and typed first errors)

forks.name: tiny-skia
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds CheckedPaint/gradient/pattern ownership and fallible request-controlled raster paths, paying/checkpointing real edge, sort, pipeline and hairline work/storage and preserving sticky errors across tiles. resvg uses CheckedPaint and *_checked raster APIs; these are absent upstream. It also routes to local controlled tiny-skia-path and png. Suppress dead_code only on retained ordinary raster adapters and callback type in optimized builds; controlled paths and other lints remain enabled.
regression_sources: src/scan/raster_control_tests.rs, src/pipeline/request_paint_tests.rs, src/pipeline/gradient_index_tests.rs (pixel parity, paid scratch/pipeline failures, wrong request, refund tails and hairline cancellation)

forks.name: tiny-skia-path
forks.changes: Keep the fork. Path/path-builder/dash/stroker storage is request-funded, fallible, COW/owner aware and cancellable; paths validate same-request ownership. usvg/resvg and the adapter call try_with_capacity, try_from_rect, try_stroke and StrokeDash::try_new_frozen. These APIs and request-policy behavior are absent upstream.
regression_sources: src/storage_tests.rs (exact paid layouts, COW/role copies, foreign request rejection, stroke/dash parity and reserve/commit/checkpoint/refund faults)

forks.name: weezl
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds decode::ControlledDecoder and storage::{Control,Buffer,...}, so GIF LZW tables/work/output remain paid and fallible within the decoder. gif directly uses these public fork APIs. It also removes the upstream bin/lzw.rs development binary; this does not affect the needed library contract. Use the equivalent Code::MAX constant instead of the deprecated max_value function.
regression_sources: fork/resvg-0.49.0/src/raster/gif_tests.rs (integration through actual controlled LZW decode)

forks.name: zune-core
forks.changes: Keep the fork. zune-jpeg uses the added bytestream::storage::{Control,Buffer,...}, controlled reader methods and sticky resource errors for all JPEG input/storage. Restoring upstream breaks both the resources feature and concrete dependent APIs. Remove an invalid crate-level macro_use attribute; module macro imports remain unchanged.

forks.name: zune-jpeg
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It threads resource control through JPEG header/entropy/Huffman, progressive state, MCU, upsample, color-convert and scalar/SIMD paths and exposes controlled::ControlledDecoder plus typed resource errors. resvg calls that decoder; this is extensive implementation work, not a path-only vendoring change. Remove an invalid crate-level macro_use attribute; module macro imports remain unchanged.
regression_sources: fork/resvg-0.49.0/src/raster/jpeg_tests.rs (actual baseline/progressive decode, raster parity, resource/retirement cases)

forks.name: harfrust
forks.changes: Adds request-bound Data/Instance/Buffer/Plan/Output, fallible FontFuncs and try_shape; threads explicit control through actual GSUB/GPOS/AAT, normalization, shaping and glyph buffers; preserves typed first failure and paid ownership. Adds read-only enclosing-mark and shaping-suppression probes against existing private Unicode tables.

forks.name: hashbrown
forks.changes: Adds controlled lookup/reserve/insert/iteration to HashMap and the existing RawTable algorithm, with fallible hash/equality/control callbacks, checkpoints during probe/control-byte fill/migration, and ownership-safe failure handling. Ordinary and controlled operations share kernels.

forks.name: kurbo
forks.changes: Adds controlled PathSeg/CubicBez arclength and inverse arclength, shares original quadrature/subdivision/ITP kernels with NoControl ordinary APIs, and defines domain/overflow/stagnation handling for tiny epsilon and adjacent floating-point brackets.

forks.name: read-fonts
forks.changes: Adds sealed TryFontRead/TryFontReadWithArgs/TryComputeSize/TryVarSize/TryTableProvider and CheckedFontRef; threads caller WorkControl through borrowed font readers, arrays/offsets, generated table constructors/dynamic ranges, CFF/PostScript execution, glyf/gvar/VARC/bitmap/color metadata and variation normalization. Outer resource failures remain distinct from inner font errors.

forks.name: resvg
forks.changes: Adds render_in_request(_with_coverage) sharing usvg ProcessingContext, paid raster/scratch owners and decode paths, checks actual render/filter/clip/mask/image work, and exposes optional request-borrowed whole-fill coverage. Raster decoders preserve typed first failure and admitted output/storage lifetimes.

forks.name: roxmltree
forks.changes: Adds optional notepads-markdown-resources support to DOM parsing/storage/tokenization, paid vectors and owned decoded/entity strings, ResourcesRef in ParsingOptions and typed Error::Resource; controls actual XML scans and ownership while retaining ordinary mode. Controlled namespace inheritance, prefix lookup and sorted insertion now prepay comparison/UTF-8 byte scans through shared request credits, poll bounded comparison windows, and move Copy namespace indices through the bounded paid slice helper. Namespace order and identities are preserved, and resource first faults propagate without an UnknownNamespace fallback. Regular markdown-svg tests cover long common prefixes, reverse insertion, namespace semantics, default-work rejection and cancellation/native faults. The short normalization-stream vendor regression measures added normalization work against an equal-DOM raw-text control so paid DOM vector migration is not mislabeled as scanning. Attribute duplicate detection meters comparison events and bounded URI/local-name equality, preserves length/pointer fast paths, polls before duplicate errors and completion, and retains first faults through cleanup.

forks.name: skrifa
forks.changes: Adds request-bound metrics/charmap/axes/location/outlines/bitmap/color/palette facades and shared controlled font kernels. Threads resource control through CFF/glyf/VARC, variation, COLR graph traversal/paint, bitmap selection and metadata; storage uses paid buffers and preserves request ownership.

forks.name: unicode-bidi
forks.changes: Adds optional controlled BidiInfo/paragraph/reorder APIs over shared explicit/implicit/prepare/UTF-16 algorithms, with paid results/scratch, explicit checkpoints, checked ranges and original error propagation. Raises local MSRV to project 1.99. Restrict alloc macro imports to tests that use the macros.

forks.name: usvg
forks.changes: Adds controlled parse and ProcessingContext/ResourcesRef propagation, explicit source-kind/reference/CSS/numeric policy, paid immutable scene/tree/cache owners, font replay/coverage/geometry/representation lifetimes, checked text/font/COLR/bitmap/SVG-glyph integration, and fallible copying/writing. Existing parser/tree/text/writer kernels consume these capabilities. The controlled OpenType gzip SVG path now uses the same locked registry miniz_oxide public streaming kernel with an exact paid InflateState, borrowed bounded header scans, multi-member/CRC framing, and state retirement before output publication; it no longer constructs hidden flate2 decoder/header heap. Ordinary DEFLATE implementation and locked versions are unchanged. Warning cleanup removes unused local adapters, gates fixture-only helpers/imports with cfg(test), documents the processing context, preserves explicit record duplication, and discards Copy cache results without drop; the root workspace alone selects the resolver.

forks.name: xmlwriter
forks.changes: Refactors the writer into one policy-selected engine and adds RequestWriter with fallible paid output/depth storage, formatting/escaping/copy checkpoints, typed first failure, and retirement-aware finish. Ordinary writer delegates to the same engine.

forks.name: fdeflate
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds Decompressor::new_controlled, paid Huffman/table storage, work/cancel checks and DecompressionError::Resources. PNG calls and matches these exact APIs; upstream lacks both the feature and the resource error variant.

forks.name: png
forks.changes: Keep the fork. It adds controlled::ControlledDecoder/check_image_pixels, paid decoder/header/text/row storage and cancellable inflate/unfilter/Adam7/transform paths. Exact-cap ICC inflation consumes later EOB/trailer windows with one paid probe byte and rejects any output beyond the unchanged cap. resvg calls the controlled APIs and PNG calls the controlled fdeflate API. Registry flate2/miniz_oxide can independently satisfy their unchanged ordinary API use. Suppress dead_code only on the retained x86_64 Paeth helper when building other architectures.
regression_sources: fork/resvg-0.49.0/src/raster/png_tests.rs (actual controlled decoding, metadata/inflate/interlace/palette and fault/cancel cases)
png/png-0.18.1/src/controlled.rs (exact inflated cap, later trailer, one-byte-over and paid retirement regression)

forks.name: syntect
forks.changes: Add borrowed per-block ExecutionControl/ExecutionMonitor with cooperative parser/include/cache/capture/scope checkpoints. Add parse_line_with_control, typed cancellation/deadline/work/resource/backend regex failures and terminal-control poisoning/reuse rejection. Use fallible once-cell compilation and propagate real regex compile/search failures without treating failure as no match.
